name: 巨潮资讯-上市银行报告
description_zh: 从巨潮资讯网（cninfo.com.cn）下载上市银行的年度报告、半年度报告和季度报告。默认采用 Team 并行模式，每家银行由一个独立 team member 负责下载，显著提升多银行批量下载速度。触发关键词：下载银行报告、年度报告、半年报、季度报告、一季报、三季报、巨潮资讯、银行年报、定期报告、批量下载。
description_en: Download annual reports, semi-annual reports, and quarterly reports of listed banks from the CNINFO website (cninfo.com.cn). By default, it uses Team parallel mode, where each bank is handled by a dedicated team member for downloading, significantly boosting the speed of bulk downloads across multiple banks. Trigger keywords: download bank reports, annual report, semi-annual report, quarterly report, Q1 report, Q3 report, CNINFO, bank annual report, periodic reports, bulk download.
